text: The Pro plan costs 20 dollars per month. The Free plan is limited to three active projects.
Priority support is included with the Pro plan. Standard support is available Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm.
Refunds can be requested within 30 days of purchase and are returned to the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days.
All data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher. Row-level security isolates each tenant's data.
The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free plan and 1000 requests per minute on the Pro plan. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.
Data can be exported as CSV or JSON. Exports larger than 1 gigabyte are delivered as a signed download link valid for 24 hours.
Single sign-on via SAML and OIDC is available on the Pro plan. SSO configuration requires an identity provider metadata URL.
Data can be hosted in the US, EU, or APAC regions. The hosting region is chosen at account creation and cannot be changed later.
